Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from this game and the warm-up matches also come to an end. The action doesn't stop though, as two Group B matches are to be played tomorrow with both spots in the Super 12 still up for grabs. The first of those matches will be played between Bangladesh and Papua New Guinea. That match will begin at 2 pm local time (10:00 am GMT). Do join us for that one. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Earlier in the day, Pakistan were put into bat and they made the most of the opportunity as they posted a sizeable total of 186 runs on the board. It looked like Pakistan were on a roll with the ball as well but then came a storm named Rassie van der Dussen, who single-handedly took the game away from them. In the end, South Africa ended up winning a thriller of a match on the final delivery.

Pakistan were just about to taste victory when it all went wrong for them. Imad Wasim gave them a dream start by uprooting both the South African openers with the score on board being just 15 runs. However, it was in the middle overs that their bowlers struggled, both the pace bowlers and spinners as well. They did manage to get rid of Bavuma and even Klaasen in the end but could not get the priced wicket of Rassie van der Dussen, which did prove to be the difference in the end. Hasan Ali had a day to forget as he was unable to defend 19 runs in the last over and this loss is exactly what Pakistan did not need heading into the tournament and having to face India in their opening match. They will now look to organise themselves and get ready for that match.

South Africa didn't have the best of starts as both their openers were back in the hut with just 15 runs on the board. The skipper, Temba Bavuma and Rassie van der Dussen steadied the ship a bit and then the latter just burst into life. The pair put on 107 runs for the third wicket as Rassie van der Dussen brought up a well compiled half-century. Bavuma was slow to start with and just when runs were flowing from his bat, he got out. Klaasen then came in and gave ample support to Rassie van der Dussen but he got out as well. With 19 needed off the last over, it was David Miller who hit one 6 and gave the strike back to red-hot Rassie van der Dussen. He finished off proceedings in style and pulled off the great escape. South Africa will now go into the main draw of the tournament high on confidence.

What a remarkable chase we have just witnessed! Rassie van der Dussen single-handedly has won the game for South Africa and it is only fitting that he is the one to hit the winning runs and also brings up a stunning century in the process. Pakistan will be gutted to watch the match slip out of their hands.

FOUR! Rassie van der Dussen hits the winning runs! A remarkable century for an outstanding performer. Absolutely brilliant knock. A full ball, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen flicks it to the vacant mid-wicket region for a boundary. SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY 6 WICKETS.
FOUR! Scores Level! What a knock this is from Rassie van der Dussen! A length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen smashes it to covers for a boundary.
Nails the yorker now, on middle. David Miller nudges it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 5 needed now.
SIX! David Miller doing what he is known for! A length ball, on the pads. David Miller crouches and whips it over square leg for a maximum. 6 needed now.
Short of a length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen slaps it through point for a single. 12 needed now.
SIX! 13 needed now! A freebie and it is dispatched! A low full toss, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen hammers it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Hasan Ali to bowl the final over.
Just a single! A length ball, on middle, flicked to square leg for a single. 19 needed in 6 balls.
FOUR! EDGY RUNS AGAIN! A length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen slashes at it. It takes the outside edge and goes over short third man for a boundary.
A length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen swings and misses. Dot ball are Gold dust right now for Pakistan.
Around off, on a length, pushed to covers for a single.
David Miller walks out to bat.

OUT! TIMBER! Is this the turning point for Pakistan? A length ball, around middle and leg. Heinrich Klaasen clears his front leg and looks to heave but misses. The ball sneaks through and rattles the stumps behind.
FOUR! EDGY RUNS! Although South Africa won't mind it! A length ball, outside off. Heinrich Klaasen looks to heave but gets an inside edge and the ball rolls over the fine leg fence.
Shaheen Afridi to bowl the penultimate over.
Now Heinrich Klaasen miscues his pull and the ball rolls to point. A single taken. 29 needed in 12 balls.
Short in length, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen mistimes his pull to deep square leg. One more single.
Length and outside off. Rassie van der Dussen drags it to square leg and collects two runs.
SIX! WHAT A SHOT! Picks it up so nicely! A full ball, slanting on middle. Rassie van der Dussen hangs back and smashes it all the way over long on for a maximum.
A length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
SIX! Good start to the over! A full ball, angling on the pads. Rassie van der Dussen tonks it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Haris Rauf (2-0-15-0) comes back on.
SIX! Much-needed one! A low full toss, on off. Heinrich Klaasen stands tall and lifs it over long off for a biggie. 47 needed in 18 balls.
A length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen knocks it through point for one.
A length ball, way outside off. Rassie van der Dussen looks to play across the line but fails to connect.
Yorker now, angling on middle. Heinrich Klaasen jams it out to mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, on off, hit back to the bowler.
Serves a full ball, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off. Rassie van der Dussen looks to sweep but miscues it on the off side. The batters take a single.
Hasan Ali (2-0-21-0) is back into the attack.
FOUR! Slower through the air, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen uses his feet and smacks it towards long on for a boundary.
On off, punched to long off for a run.
Loopy ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Outside off, pushed towards covers for a quick run.
Full and on middle, Rassie van der Dussen reverse-sweeps it to third man for one.
Heinrich Klaasen is in at number 5. Also, Imad Wasim (2-0-10-2) comes back into the attack.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Length ball, on middle. Temba Bavuma once again looks to paddle scoop. Doesn't get it from the middle of the bat. The ball goes towards the left of the keeper. Mohammad Rizwan does very well to dive that side quickly and takes the catch. Pakistan get the much needed breakthrough. 65 needed from 30 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Rizwan b Shaheen Afridi

Commentary.Commentary: On the pads, Bavuma whips it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Nicely played! A low full toss on off, Temba Bavuma paddle-scoops it towards fine leg for a boundary.

On off, Rassie van der Dussen smashes it to mid off. He takes off for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. 100-run partnership comes up between Temba Bavuma and Rassie van der Dussen.
Length ball, on middle. Temba Bavuma taps it to point for one.
Length ball, on off. Rassie van der Dussen pushes it to mid off for a single.
Shaheen Afridi (2-0-11-0) is back into the attack.
SIX! Up and over! Tosses it up, on middle. Temba Bavuma dances down the track and launches it over long on for a biggie. 14 runs from the over.
Loopy ball, on middle. Temba Bavuma keeps it out.
On off, punched towards covers for a single.
Full and on middle, Rassie van der Dussen shimmies down the track and works it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs. He gets to his fifty off just 29 balls.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Loopy ball, on off. Rassie van der Dussen reverse-sweeps it to the third man region for a boundary. Moves to 49 now.
Floats it up, on off. Temba Bavuma nudges it to square leg for a single. 100 up for South Africa!
Length ball, on middle. Bavuma smacks it to deep mid-wicket. There is protection in the deep and will only get a single.
Full and on the pads, Rassie van der Dussen whips it to mid-wicket for a single. Haris Rauf appeals for an LBW but the umpire shakes his head. There was clear bat on it.
WIDE! An effort ball from Haris Rauf, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen sways away from it. Wide called for height.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen looks to smash it on the leg side but only connects it with thin air around him.
Fuller in length, on middle. Driven towards cover for a single.
On a length, on off. Rassie van der Dussen pushes it towards covers for one.
Good-length ball, on off. Hurries onto the batter. Rassie van der Dussen gets an outside edge. The ball flies over point and the batters take two.
Haris Rauf comes back into the attack.
Nicely flighted, around off. Temba Bavuma strides out and looks to sweep but fails to connect and gets hit on the pads. 95 now required off 48 balls.
Excellent running! Flatter one, on middle and this is gently nudged towards mid-wicket for yet another two.
Temba Bavuma skips down the track and works the tossed up delivery through mid-wicket for a couple.
Slower through the air, on middle. Bavuma looks to reverse paddle it fine but the ball comes off the gloves and goes nowehere.
Floated up, around off and swept away to deep square leg for a single.
Short ball, on middle. Bavuma makes room and pulls it down to wide long on for a run.
FOUR! Short ball, slower in pace but down the leg side. Rassie van der Dussen waits for it and helps it round the corner into the fine leg fence. 15 off the over, a good one for South Africa.

SIX! WOW! Improvisation at its best from Rassie van der Dussen. A length ball, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen just walks across his stumps and scoops it over the keeper's head and the ball sails over the ropes.
Back of a length, Rassie van der Dussen short arm jabs it towards wide long on and gets back for an easy two.
Ali bangs it in short, around middle. Bavuma looks to pull but mistimes it uppishly towards backward square leg. They get a single.
Short of a good-length, around off. Temba Bavuma strokes it through covers off the back foot and picks up a couple.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Bavuma defends it out.

DRINKS! Pakistan have done well to keep things quiet although 26 runs came from the last two overs. Both the openers departed for single-digit scores and now the onus will be on Rassie van der Dussen and Temba Bavuma to keep the scoreboard ticking. One of them will have to play agressively as the required run rate is creeping up rapidly with 116 needed from the final 10 overs. Hasan Ali comes into the attack.
Dragged down, around middle, Bavuma rocks back and pulls it in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Short and outside off, Bavuma cuts it to point.
On middle, worked to mid-wicket for a single.

FIVE WIDES! That will help South Africa's cause. Down the leg side, Rassie van der Dussen looks to sweep but misses. The keeper fails to collect it as well and the ball races away to the fine leg fence.
Flatter ball, around off. Bavuma goes on the back foot and cuts it towards point for a run.
Tossed up, around leg stump. Rassie van der Dussen skips down the track and works it to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Pre-meditated reverse sweep from Rassie van der Dussen. Floated delivery, on middle and reverse swept into the point fence.
An excellent yorker, right on the money. Temba Bavuma does well to keep it out.
On the pads and flicked to deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Slow, dipping full toss on the pads. Rassie van der Dussen just helps it round the corner and picks up a boundary.
On top of middle and worked through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. The throw from the deep is a wild one and they get an extra run as well.
FOUR! Down the leg side and Temba Bavuma tickles it fine, past the short fine leg fielder and picks up a boundary.
A length ball, slanting into middle and leg. Rassie van der Dussen tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and on off. Rassie van der Dussen turns it to deep square leg for a single. 142 needed in 72 balls.
Loopy ball, on off, pushed to deep cover for a single.
Again goes for the paddle sweep but fails to connect.
A tossed up ball, on middle. Temba Bavuma pushes it uppishly straight back to the bowler. Shadab Khan dives to carry but grabs it on a bounce.
Around off, kept out.
A full ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma shuffles across and looks to sweep but misses.
FOUR! In the gap! A full ball, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen gets on his knee and sweeps it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Shadab Khan comes in to roll his arms.
WIDE! Down the leg side and is given as a wide.
Full and on middle, drilled down to long on for a single.
Short in length, on the bodyline. Temba Bavuma looks to pull but gets hit on the body.
Full and on middle, flicked to square leg.
A length ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma stands tall and looks to drive but fails to get any bat on it.
Around off, pushed to covers for a single.
Mohammad Wasim comes into the attack for the first time today.
A length ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma looks to drive but misses. At the end of the Powerplay, South Africa are 36/2.
A low full toss, on middle. flicked to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Slightly short, on middle. Nudged to square leg for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Bavuma steers it to backward point for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen knocks it to covers for a quick single.
On a length, on off. Bavuma dabs it to third man for a single.
Hasan Ali comes into the attack now.
A short ball, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it through square leg for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Good shot! A half-volley on off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it through covers for a boundary.
On a length, on off. Bavuma taps it to covers for a single.
A length ball, angling around off. Temba Bavuma shuffles across and looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal follows for LBW but not given.
Full and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Excellent delivery to start with! A length ball, outside off, nipping back in. Rassie van der Dussen looks to defend but gets beaten on the inside edge.
Haris Rauf comes into the attack now.
Outside off, Temba Bavuma dabs it to point.
Good-length ball, on off. Temba Bavuma blocks it out from the crease.
On a length, on off, tapped to point.
SIX! THUMPED! A short ball, on middle. Temba Bavuma rides the bounce and pulls it over square leg for a biggie.
Short and on middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Full, on middle. Pushed back to the bowler.
Temba Bavuma is the new man in.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Flatter delivery, outside off. Reeza Hendricks looks to push it on the off side. The ball goes off the inside edge and crashes onto the stumps behind him. Both the openers are sent packing and early signs of trouble for South Africa.
On the pads, played to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter ball, on leg. Rassie van der Dussen nudges it on the leg side.
Rassie van der Dussen is in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Imad Wasim gets rid of the big fish here. Floats it up, outside off. Quinton de Kock shimmies down the track and looks to go inside out. Doesn't get quite to the pitch of the ball and ends up lobbing it towards cover. A nothing shot really. Asif Ali takes the simplest of catches to dismiss Quinton de Kock. An early blow to South Africa.
Commentary.Howout: c Asif Ali b Imad Wasim

Commentary.Commentary: Loopy ball, on middle. Reeza Hendricks whips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter ball, outside off. Reeza Hendricks lifts it towards wide long off for a brace.
On middle, worked to mid-wicket. Reeza Hendricks retains the strike by taking a run.
Short of a length, outside off. Quinton de Kock pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Good-length ball, on off, angling in. Reeza Hendricks looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. Shaheen Afridi appeals for an LBW but nothing from the umpire.
Length ball, on off. Quinton de Kock wrists it around the corner and scampers across for a single.
On a good length, on off. Reeza Hendricks pushes it to point for a quick single.
Who will bowl from the other end? It's going to be Shaheen Afridi.
On the pads, Reeza Hendricks turns it to mid-wicket for a run. A good over from Imad Wasim. Only 6 runs from it.
Flatter ball, on middle. Quinton de Kock works it to mid-wicket for one.
Floats it up, outside off, Quinton de Kock lofts it towards deep cover for a couple of runs.
Quicker delivery, skidding on, on off. Reeza Hendricks nudges it to mid on for one.
Loopy ball, on middle. Quinton de Kock sweeps it to square leg for a single. South Africa and Quinton de Kock are underway!
Flatter ball, outside off. Quinton de Kock slashes it towards covers.
